title: The Menu, Week 6
dek: Kenneth Walker III comes off the bye as RB1, Woody Marks jumps to RB20, and Christian Watson is WR4 after 143 yards and 2 TDs.
author: Chef Hazy
intro_md:
Updated Thu 6:20 PM ET: Jalen Hurts is ruled out vs CAR and comes off the Menu; Tanner McKee starts, so Patrick Mahomes II moves up to QB9 and Tyler Shough to QB12, a borderline start. David Montgomery is ruled out too, and Woody Marks stays RB20 @JAX, an RB2. Rashee Rice, Chris Olave, Jeremiyah Love, Lamar Jackson and Quinshon Judkins missed practice again, and Mike Evans sat Thursday with the ribs and Achilles; the final injury reports decide all six. Caleb Williams and Michael Penix Jr. practiced in full.

Updated Wed 7:25 PM ET: Jaxon Smith-Njigba practiced in full Wednesday and has no designation for Thursday @DEN; he stays WR2 for me. David Montgomery missed practice again, so Woody Marks stays RB20 @JAX, an RB2.

Updated Wed 6:10 PM ET: CeeDee Lamb practiced in full Wednesday and stays WR3 for me @GB. Chris Olave missed practice with an illness and stays WR6 until Thursday's report says otherwise. Ashton Jeanty plays vs BUF, per Klint Kubiak, at RB13, borderline RB1/RB2. Breece Hall is likely out again, so Braelon Allen is RB19 @NE, an RB2. Jeremiyah Love rested the ankle Wednesday and stays RB18, an RB2, and Alvin Kamara was limited and stays RB26, a high-end RB3.

Updated Wed 4:55 PM ET: Lamar Jackson has not practiced since the Oct. 4 ankle injury, so he drops to QB16 for me @CLE, a streamer, with Tyler Huntley starting if he sits and Friday's injury report deciding it. Caleb Williams was full on Chicago's estimate and climbs to QB8 @ATL. Quinshon Judkins did not practice Wednesday and falls to RB33 vs BAL, a low-end RB3 and a low-end flex play. Rashee Rice moves up to WR27 vs LAC, a high-end WR3, and he is still a sit without a full practice by Friday. Brenton Strange is TE12 vs HOU, a borderline start, and Pat Freiermuth slips to TE13 @TB.

Updated Wed 4:35 PM ET: Lamar Jackson did not practice Wednesday with the ankle. He stays QB5 for me @CLE until Friday's injury report, and Tyler Huntley starts if he sits. Michael Penix Jr. practiced and is Atlanta's starter vs CHI if all goes to plan; he stays QB22, outside my top 12. Caleb Williams was full on Chicago's estimate and stays QB13, a borderline start. Rashee Rice did not practice; WR38 for me, a low-end flex play to a dart throw, and a sit without a full practice by Friday.

Week 6 has four teams on bye: Cincinnati, Detroit, Miami and Minnesota are off, so none of their players are on the Menu. Seattle opens @DEN Thursday, Houston and Jacksonville play at 9:30 AM ET in London, Arizona @LAR kicks at 4:05, the Chargers @KC and Buffalo @LV at 4:25, Dallas @GB Sunday night and Washington @SF Monday night. Rankings are for full PPR.

Josh Allen sits alone at QB1 after running for 121 at the Rams, and Kenneth Walker III comes off the bye as RB1 ahead of Bijan Robinson. Puka Nacua (17 of 24 targets vs BUF) and Jaxon Smith-Njigba lead the receivers, and Brock Bowers is TE1. Woody Marks moves into the RB2 range at RB20 with David Montgomery week to week.

Deebo Samuel Sr., A.J. Brown, Roman Wilson, David Montgomery and Tre' Harris are off the Menu. Lamar Jackson, Caleb Williams, Saquon Barkley, Quinshon Judkins, Michael Penix Jr. and CeeDee Lamb all start the week with a question; Prep Notes revisits every one of them Friday with the injury report.
